evals.prompt: Use the OpenRouter analytics skill at ./SKILL.md to run its bundled query-template helper and show the query for finding which models drive most of my spend. I don't have a management key yet, so don't execute an authenticated query. This is a managed skill directory; keep its files unchanged and do not install dependencies inside it.
evals.expected_output: The bundled suggest-queries.ts runs with the cache-based runner. The agent shows the spend-by-model template without requesting credentials or contacting authenticated endpoints.
expectations: The agent executes the bundled suggest-queries.ts using npx --yes tsx@4.22.3.
The result includes total_usage and request_count, dimensions model, and descending total_usage ordering from the helper output.
The skill directory is unchanged and contains no node_modules.
The agent does not execute an authenticated analytics query or request a management key.
